description: An abstract class defining an authentication provider interface within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies methods for authentication and retrieving priority, intended to be extended by concrete providers.

classes.name: AbstractAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class for authentication providers, requiring implementation of authentication logic and priority retrieval.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Abstract method to authenticate given authentication parameters. Should return true if successful, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the priority ranking of the authentication provider.
